accepted.sentence: During vehicle alignment, technicians loosen tie-rod locknuts so the adjuster can be rotated to correct wheel toe.
Sailboat crews secure turnbuckle adjustments with locknuts to maintain tension in the standing rigging.
When installing rooftop solar panels, crews tighten module-clamp nuts to keep the panels fixed against wind loads.
A mechanic loosens the crank-arm retaining bolt when removing a bicycle crank for bottom-bracket service.
On a garage door, technicians tighten track-bracket nuts to keep the guides aligned as the rollers travel.
After replacing a toilet fill valve, a plumber tightens the tank's supply-line coupling nut to prevent leaks.
Railway maintenance crews tighten fishplate bolts to keep adjoining rail sections joined under repeated wheel loads.
A licensed installer tightens gas-line fittings after assembly, then checks the joints for leaks before use.
